cases.name: ScrollConstraint velocity and scrollActive during drag
cases.note: The executable fixture port preserves the vertical asset, default artboard occurrence, named state machine, first retained ScrollConstraint, initial advance, every pointer coordinate and action, the 0.1/0.0/0.1 advances, release order, and all idle/drag/velocity/physics-running/scrollActive assertions through live runtime owners.

adaptation.inapplicable_observable: C++ non-deterministic ScrollPhysics sampling of std::chrono::high_resolution_clock at the exact wall-clock instant of the drag-move event
adaptation.rationale: The Rust host API does not sample an ambient wall clock for pointer movement, so the port supplies deterministic timestamp 1.0 after the zero-time drag start. The pinned observable is only that vertical velocity becomes nonzero while the orthogonal/held-still values and activity flags retain their exact assertions; no wall-clock-derived numeric magnitude is asserted.
